entities.summary: Samuel Morris III is a former professional American football running back in the National Football League (NFL) for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and Dallas Cowboys. He was selected by the Buffalo Bills in the fifth round of the 2000 NFL draft. He played college football at Texas Tech University.
